additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398928-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002519] Door is not closing properly CRM:01811000566
additional_info.body:
Dear Quality Team,
I hope you are doing well.
We’ve encountered an issue with Charger
MP / R8 170002519
, which was installed yesterday at the site but has not yet been commissioned. The charger’s door is not closing properly, and we are unable to proceed with the commissioning process due to this problem. Please see the attached video and images that show the issue in more detail.
Additionally, if you look at the first image from another charger, you will see that there are two plates at the bottom. However, in the image of the new charger (170002519), there is only one plate. I believe this discrepancy might be causing the door issue.
Could you please assist us with investigating this issue? Below are the details:
Charger Model
: MP / R8 170002519
Issue
: The door is not closing properly.
Installation Status
: Installed, but not yet commissioned.
we would also appreciate it if you could provide part numbers and descriptions for any spare parts needed.
We look forward to your guidance in resolving the issue.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
